title: cyanea horrida
intro: Cyanea horrida, commonly known as the Hawaiian Violet, is a rare, flowering plant native to the island of Hawaii. It has been used in traditional Hawaiian medicine for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Cyanea horrida include soothing skin irritations, reducing pain, and promoting wound healing, making it a valuable resource for natural remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
